description: List SENS projects (GET /common/v2/projects). Each project carries the per-channel service IDs in NRN form — smsService.serviceId, kkoBizMsgService.serviceId and mailService.serviceId (ncp:mail:kr:…) — which the SMS/Alimtalk/Mail tools take as serviceId; useMail marks projects with the Mail channel. Projects migrated from Cloud Outbound Mailer are named 'mail-<UUID>'.

projectName.description: Filter by project name (full or partial match)
